quotes.author: Nat MD
quotes.text: Had an amazing experience with the captain today …took the kids out boating, and everything was organized, smooth, and family-friendly. He was welcoming, helpful, and made the whole experience enjoyable from start to finish. The boat was clean, comfortable and well-maintained. A perfect day on the water with my family. We will definitely be back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a fun day out. 🎣🚤☀️

quotes.author: Sue Spinney
quotes.text: We cannot say enough good things about our recent sunset cruise with Captain Randy. It was everything we hoped for—the boat was amazing, the music was excellent, and the snacks provided were a great touch. Additionally, Captain Randy was very knowledgeable and shared wonderful information about the area. We highly recommend this reasonably priced, first-class experience!

quotes.author: Rose Mastin
quotes.text: Randy had all of our bases covered, which was wonderful. But as a family with two small children (4 and 6) his eye for safety and communication was what made us the most impressed. I will be using him for all of our future bookings he was also great with the kids and that made me even more comfortable on this boat tour.

quotes.author: Brandon Davis
quotes.text: The most fun I've had in a while! We booked Sunset Cruises for my bachelor party and had a blast. Our captain, Randy, was super accommodating and made sure we were good every step of the way. He even provided snacks and water. Would highly recommend!

quotes.author: Laura Gangnier
quotes.text: Randy is an amazing Captain!! Highly recommended!! He’s knowledgeable, knows the waters like the back of his hand, has a beautiful boat and knows his music too!! Thank you Randy for an amazing night on the water!! We will definitely be back!

quotes.author: Carlos Herriott II
quotes.text: Randy provided an exceptional experience for our groom on his bachelor trip!
